note: What every writer of the PRD 7.2 audit trail agrees on. The schema part is written by services/dataplane/audit (UPDATE_AUDIT_CONTRACT=1); services/gateway/audit and services/collab are held to it. Do not edit the schema by hand.

queries.checks: SELECT conname || '|' || pg_get_constraintdef(c.oid) FROM pg_constraint c JOIN pg_class r ON r.oid = c.conrelid JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = r.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname = $1 AND r.relname = 'records' ORDER BY conname
queries.columns: SELECT column_name || '|' || data_type || '|' || is_nullable || '|' || coalesce(column_default, '') FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = $1 AND table_name = 'records' ORDER BY ordinal_position
queries.functions: SELECT p.proname || '|' || regexp_replace(p.prosrc, '\s+', ' ', 'g') FROM pg_proc p JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = p.pronamespace WHERE n.nspname = $1 ORDER BY p.proname
queries.triggers: SELECT t.tgname || '|' || pg_get_triggerdef(t.oid) FROM pg_trigger t JOIN pg_class r ON r.oid = t.tgrelid JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = r.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname = $1 AND r.relname = 'records' AND NOT t.tgisinternal ORDER BY t.tgname

functions: refuse| BEGIN RAISE EXCEPTION '% on the audit trail is refused: it is append-only', TG_OP; END
triggers: no_change|CREATE TRIGGER no_change BEFORE DELETE OR UPDATE ON <schema>.records FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION <schema>.refuse()
no_truncate|CREATE TRIGGER no_truncate BEFORE TRUNCATE ON <schema>.records FOR EACH STATEMENT EXECUTE FUNCTION <schema>.refuse()
